title: Find the hidden typo
brief: A JavaScript config has a misspelled key 'adress'. Search for it and change it to 'address' without retyping the rest of the line.
why: Searching jumps straight to the typo, and ce replaces the misspelled word from the cursor to its end, so you retype only that word and nothing else on the line.
author: claude (daily)
hint: Combine / to jump and ce to fix the word ending.
